items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: Well my father was a musician and uh, he played music through the years.

ctx.x: 1916, I see. So you're considerably younger than Bailey. Fair much so, yeah. Uh, and how did you happen to get interested in music? Did you hear any music around when you were a kid?

Well my father was a musician and uh, he played music through the years. As a matter of fact my family, you know, all were musically inclined and practically everybody in the family played some type of musical instrument. And actually when I grew up I sort of became a part of me.
